hypotheses.mechanism: Leverage accumulation may precede broad damage.
hypotheses.feature: ln(oiCcy at last complete observation available by A-1h) - ln(oiCcy at last complete observation available by A-24h)
hypotheses.availability_rule: availability=max(provider_ts,retrieval_end_utc), both endpoints no later than their cutoff
hypotheses.missingness_rule: drop full pair if either endpoint absent, late, nonpositive, unit-inconsistent or mapping-changed; no fill or venue substitution

hypotheses.mechanism: Realized positive funding may represent crowding and leverage carrying burden before broad damage.
hypotheses.feature: sum realized fundingRate with fundingTime in [A-24h,A-1h] and availability no later than A-1h
hypotheses.availability_rule: fundingTime is event time; availability=max(provider response time,retrieval_end_utc); predicted or next funding forbidden
hypotheses.missingness_rule: require at least two realized events and complete pagination in event and control windows; otherwise drop pair

hypotheses.mechanism: Executable bid-liquidity withdrawal may precede broad damage.
hypotheses.feature: -ln(median 5-minute bid quote depth within 50bps of mid over T-24..T-1 / median same measure over T-72..T-25)
hypotheses.availability_rule: every snapshot reconstructed from contiguous diff-depth sequence received by snapshot cutoff; availability=receive_time_utc
hypotheses.missingness_rule: any sequence gap, stale bootstrap, missing snapshot or <90% scheduled snapshot coverage drops pair; no interpolation

hypotheses.mechanism: Short-dated downside protection demand may precede broad damage.
hypotheses.feature: hourly: nearest expiry 7<=DTE<14, put abs(delta) nearest .25 and call delta nearest .25 each within .05; skew=put mark_iv-call mark_iv; risk_score=median hourly skew T-24..T-1
hypotheses.availability_rule: expiry, delta and IV must coexist in same frozen top-of-hour chain snapshot and be received by cutoff
hypotheses.missingness_rule: require matched put/call within delta tolerance for at least 20 of 24 hourly snapshots in both event and control; otherwise drop pair

global_rejection_rule: one-sided synchronized block-preserving max-T adjusted p<=0.05 across all four primaries, correct direction, paired concordance>=0.67, simultaneous lower bound>=0.55, block consistency and influence gates
